newsitem.title: NEPAL: Woman arrested for killing cow in Nepal.
newsitem.headline: Woman arrested for killing cow in Nepal.

text.p: Nepali police have arrested an 82-year-old woman for killing a cow, state-owned news agency RSS said on Wednesday.
Hiradevi Bista, 82, of the western town of Mahendranagar poisoned her neighbour's cow, it said. She was arrested after an official autopsy confirmed the poisoning.
Nepal bars the slaughter of cows, considered a sacred animal in the world's only Hindu kingdom. If convicted, Bista could be sentenced to up to 12 years in jail, RSS said.
